cause: The documented W5 order says integrate before cleanup, while local merge_queue implementation requires the branch to be detached before checkout and does not surface that requirement during dry-run.
prevention: Add an attached-worktree preflight and regression, then make merge-integrator documentation choose one canonical safe path: verified detach before checkout or integration through the existing worker worktree.
summary: TASK-AR-652 local integration failed before verification because the worker branch was still attached to its clean worktree while merge_queue tried to check it out in the integrator checkout.
title: Make merge integration aware of attached worker worktrees
